job.title: SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead
job.description:
This is: the job
An exciting opportunity for an experienced SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead to take ownership of the reporting and analytics workstream within a major enterprise SAP transformation in Melbourne.

This hands-on leadership role will shape the target-state reporting architecture across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, embedded analytics and Fiori-based reporting. You will set the strategy and standards while remaining actively involved in solution design, data modelling, quality assurance and delivery.

This 12-month contract is ideal for someone who has successfully led SAP reporting and analytics through a full S/4HANA implementation and enjoys combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical decision-making.

This is: what you'll do

  • Lead the reporting and analytics workstream across SAP S/4HANA and the broader SAP analytics landscape.
  • Define the target-state reporting architecture and determine the right approach across embedded, real-time and enterprise reporting.
  • Drive requirements workshops with business stakeholders and functional leads to prioritise statutory, operational, management and self-service reporting.
  • Oversee the design and delivery of reports, dashboards, KPIs, CDS views and analytical data models.
  • Establish standards for semantic models, data models, dashboards, KPI definitions, naming conventions and version control.
  • Drive report rationalisation, reducing unnecessary legacy reporting and promoting standard SAP functionality and clean-core principles.
  • Manage reporting testing across SIT, UAT, data reconciliation and defect resolution.
  • Collaborate with data migration, security, architecture, integration and functional teams to deliver trusted, governed and secure reporting.
  • Lead SAP Datasphere and SAC consultants and partner resources, managing priorities, delivery quality, risks and dependencies.
  • Define the transition to hypercare and BAU, including knowledge transfer, documentation, support processes and ongoing enhancement governance.

This is: what you'll need

  • Proven experience leading a reporting and analytics workstream through at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation, from design through to hypercare.
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Data Products and S/4HANA embedded analytics.
  • Practical experience with CDS views, Fiori analytical applications, analytical models, dashboards and KPI frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of SAP data models and reporting across areas such as FI/CO, MM, SD and/or PP.
  • Experience translating complex business reporting requirements and KPIs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of reporting governance, data quality, reconciliation, business glossaries and metric definitions.
  • Understanding of role-based access, row-level security and reporting authorisation requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience leading delivery teams, consultants and implementation partner resources.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including confidence working with senior business, technical and program leaders.
  • Excellent analytical, communication and problem-solving skills with the ability to challenge legacy approaches and drive pragmatic outcomes.

This is: the perks

  • Take ownership of reporting and analytics within a significant enterprise-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Shape the future-state analytics landscape across SAC, Datasphere, embedded analytics and SAP data capabilities.
  • Work with senior program leaders, functional teams and specialist SAP resources in a highly visible role.
  • Build valuable end-to-end transformation experience across design, build, testing, cutover, hypercare and transition to BAU.

Join a major enterprise transformation program integrating Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA and cloud-based business solutions. This hands-on Test Coordinator role will help ensure testing is effectively planned, traceable and delivered across a complex, multi-system environment.

You will work closely with testing teams, business users, architects, developers and other stakeholders across sales, distribution, supply chain, logistics, procurement, inventory and finance.   • Experience working with complex, large-scale and multi-system integration programs
  • Strong capability in test planning, test case design, execution and defect management
  • Hands-on experience with Jira, qTest and Confluence
  • Clear communication and confident stakeholder engagement skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively across business and technology teams
  • A practical, delivery-focused approach to identifying and resolving testing issues

  • Contribute to a high-visibility enterprise transformation spanning Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA and cloud platforms

job.title: SAP Instructional Designer / Trainer

We're seeking an experienced SAP Instructional Designer / Trainer to play a key role in a large-scale ERP transformation program delivering SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud across Finance, Supply Chain, Asset Management and Service Operations. This is a Melbourne based, 9 month contract working within a nationally significant program.

You'll be responsible for designing, developing and delivering end-to-end learning solutions that support business readiness, capability uplift and successful adoption of new SAP business processes. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys creating engaging learning experiences and confidently facilitating training across a diverse stakeholder group.

You'll work closely with change, project and business teams to develop learning content, deliver training, support super user networks and contribute to go-live readiness and hypercare activities.

This is: what you'll do

  • Design and develop SAP-focused learning solutions aligned to business processes and user roles
  • Create engaging instructor-led, virtual and eLearning content using modern instructional design principles
  • Develop learning pathways, curricula, job aids, quick reference guides and performance support materials
  • Deliver end-user training across classroom and virtual environments using SAP training systems
  • Collaborate with Change Managers, Business Analysts, Functional Consultants and Solution Architects
  • Build and maintain high-quality training content repositories and governance standards
  • Support Train-the-Trainer and Super User networks to enable scalable business readiness
  • Contribute to go-live readiness activities, hypercare support and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Design and develop WalkMe digital adoption content including guided walkthroughs and task support tools
  • Measure learning effectiveness and implement improvements across phased deployments

This is: what you'll need

  • 5+ years' experience as an Instructional Designer supporting SAP ERP implementations
  • 5+ years' SAP training delivery experience, ideally within SAP S/4HANA environments
  • Strong understanding of Finance, Supply Chain, Asset Management and/or Service Management business processes
  • Experience developing training materials using Articulate Rise or similar authoring tools
  • Proven ability to translate complex system processes into practical, role-based learning experiences
  • Experience working within large-scale ERP, digital transformation or enterprise change programs
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and communication skills
  • Experience designing Digital Adoption Platform solutions such as WalkMe highly regarded
